title: Operation Shadow Login — Automated Cluster
summary: Multiple alerts on SERVER01 and jdoe correlate to prior phishing incident.

attack_analysis_steps.description: Phishing email observed for jdoe; malicious link clicked.
Suspicious RDP session to SERVER01 from jdoe's workstation.
PsExec-style remote execution detected on SERVER01.

executive_summary: Phishing against jdoe was followed within minutes by RDP and PsExec activity on SERVER01, indicating lateral movement on a high-value asset.
